findings.issue: The import statements use the '@/...' alias (e.g., '@/components/Layout') but the project does not define a corresponding path alias in either Vite or TypeScript configuration. This will cause a module resolution error at runtime/build time.
The code uses a non‑null assertion (`document.getElementById('root')!`) which will throw a runtime error if the element with id 'root' is missing from the HTML.
